info.prompt: Bio-mechanical dice chamber where Gothic arches drip with liquid neon data streams, illuminating a central playing field of translucent bone-white tiles. Every fifth turn triggers a gravity flip—arrows flash as the entire grid rotates 90 degrees with a 400ms physics settle, sending dice sliding along new vector paths. Hidden pocket slot glows faintly beside the HUD, its "Hidden: 5" tooltip hovering until deployment while racing position indicators pulse PRESSURE/SLIPSTREAM/CRUISE status in tri-color gradients.
